RECOMMENDATION: DON'T RAISE IT
LIKELIHOOD: Cannot responsibly assign a number from these facts.

An all-women panel is not, by itself, evidence of sex bias. Your stronger publication record and completed PhD merit asking how the criteria were applied, but industry experience, teaching quality, interview performance, and departmental needs may legitimately outweigh those differences.

Follow up now on your written request. Ask for the selection criteria, their weighting, your assessment, and any available review procedure. Check applicable complaint deadlines rather than waiting indefinitely.

Raise sex discrimination if concrete evidence emerges—for example, sex-based remarks or inconsistent application of criteria—not simply because the panel members were women. Any rule requiring gender-balanced panels depends on the jurisdiction and university.
